integrity: The proof is analytic and separates the exact transport argument from finite computational corroboration. The closest recent papers were inspected at the proposition and application level, and targeted literature and database searches found no covering statement; search failure is not treated as novelty proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite identity is classical for Hamming cost. The quantum corollary is an upper bound for arbitrary prepared states and is exact for mutually orthogonal signal states. The fixed-type asymptotic constant is stated along admissible block lengths for a fixed rational type; no second-order correction is claimed.
title: Exact type-class Wasserstein transport and the sharp \(n^{-1/2}\) almost-i.i.d. scale
